inlineSql: SELECT * FROM SL_DATA AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME AS PartyNameL,A.AC_CODE AS AcCodeL,A.VCH_NO AS VchNoT,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS OrderDtL,A.RTN_BILL_OS AS CrntAmtR,CASE WHEN SUM(B.CRNT_AMT) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SUM(B.CRNT_AMT) END As AdjAmtR,A.CO_YEAR AS YearL,A.CO_BOOK as BookL,A.HD_VCH_NO As HdVchNoL FROM (SL_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN CRNT_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.CRNT_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CRNT_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.CRNT_NO)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.MAIN_BOOK = 'SALES RETURNE' AND C.BOOK_TYPE = ? M ? 'F' ? ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.RTN_BILL_OS,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.HD_VCH_NO HAVING (CASE WHEN SUM(B.CRNT_AMT) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SUM(B.CRNT_AMT) END) < A.RTN_BILL_OS ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
SELECT UPI_TYPE As UpiTypeL From UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND UPI_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY UPI_TYPE
SELECT DISTINCT UPI_TYPE As UpiTypeL From UPI_DATA ORDER BY UPI_TYPE
SELECT UPI_ID,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO FROM UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND UPI_ID = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT GR_RATE FROM RATE_MAST AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.IT_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
Select * From DM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.DM_NAME As ItemNameL,A.DM_CODE as ItCodeL,B.GR_NAME As GroupL FROM DM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.DM_NAME
UPDATE APR_DETL SET APR_DETL.ISU_REC = 'N' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND SR_NO = ?
UPDATE BAR_DETL SET BAR_DETL.APR_ISU = 'Y' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?
UPDATE BAR_DETL SET BAR_DETL.APP_TRFR = 'R' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?

Select A.ORD_NO As OrdNoL,D.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.ORD_YRCD As OrdYrCdL,A.ORD_DBCD As OrdDbCdL,A.ORD_SRNO As OrdSrNoL,B.TAG_STK_LESS As TagStkLessM From ((BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ORD_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ORD_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ORD_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ORD_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.ORD_AC = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.ORD_NO <> '' AND B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.ORD_AC = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY A.ORD_NO,A.TAG_NO
SELECT * FROM SL_ORD_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND OLD_SRNO = ' ? '

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_ORD_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?

SELECT A.AC_NAME AS AcNameL,A.VCH_DATE AS OrderDtL,A.VCH_NO AS OrderNoL, B.ITM_REMARK AS ItemNameL,B.DESIGN_NO AS DesignL,B.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,B.ITM_RATE AS RateR ,B.LBR_RATE AS LbrRateR,LBR_AMT As LbrAmtR,B.ITM_GHT_WT As GhtWtW,B.RATE_FIX As RatFixM FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A INNER JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = B.VCH_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ADV_AMT - A.ORD_ADJ_AMT > 0 OR B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.AC_CODE IN ('00020',' ? ') ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY SUBSTRING(C.DESIGN_NO,1,2), LEN(C.DESIGN_NO),C.DESIGN_NO,A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME,B.GR_CODE,B.RATE_TYPE As RateType,B.DISC_PRC As LbrDisc,B.MRP_DISC_PRC As MrpDisc,B.AC_MEMB_COM_PRC,B.ITM_FIX_GHT_PRC As FixGhtPrc FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ' ? '
SELECT GR_RATE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? GR_CODE ? '
Select AC_MEMB_COM_PRC From TOUCH_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_MEMB_COM_PRC <> 0

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?

SELECT ITM_LOT,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY ITM_LOT HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) > 0

SELECT A.ITM_LOT As ItmLotL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,B.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWtW FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME ORDER BY A.ITM_LOT,B.IT_NAME
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND BULK_SALE <> 'N' ?
Select AC_LBR_RATE,AC_LBR_PRC From TOUCH_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_LBR_RATE+AC_LBR_PRC <> 0
Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' and LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TABLE_NAME As CounterL,TABLE_CODE as CodeL FROM TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
Select * From EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,EMP_CODE as CodeL FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_CODE
SELECT * FROM ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND IT_DESIGN = 'N' ? AND IT_DESIGN = ' ? ' ? AND FROM_WT <= ? AND TO_WT >= ?
SELECT MIN_LBR_PRC FROM ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND FROM_WT <= ? AND TO_WT >= ? AND MIN_LBR_PRC <> 0

Select A.ITM_LOT,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) AS StkPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) AS StkGwt, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS StkNwt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT

Select A.IT_CODE,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) AS StkPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) AS StkGwt, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS StkNwt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT A.IT_CODE,A.GR_CODE,B.MELTING_PRC FROM ITEM_MAST AS A INNER JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.MELTING_PRC <> 0
SELECT * FROM MSG_MAST WHERE MSG_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY MSG_TYPE
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PRINT_TYPE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = '01' AND PRINT_TYPE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE
SELECT * FROM TAX_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAX_CODE = ' ? '
